trigger_cases.prompt: Prepare my 1:1 meeting agenda with my direct report Alex.
Debrief this 1:1 sync and record mutual commitments.
Structure a career coaching check-in using Andy Grove's High Output Management.
Track two-way action items from my manager one-on-one.
Help me give radical candor feedback in tomorrow's 1:1.
Implement a binary search tree in C++.
Set up a Kubernetes ingress controller on AWS EKS.
Generate a SQL schema migration for billing subscriptions.
Write an integration test for our OAuth token refresh endpoint.

binary_cases.prompt: Create the commitment contract from this 1:1 debrief.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Includes two-way commitments separating Direct Report actions from Manager unblocking actions.
must_not: one-sided list with only subordinate tasks and no manager commitments
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
### Direct Report Commitments
| @Alex | Ship API schema | 2026-09-05 |
### Manager Unblocking Commitments
| @Sarah (Manager) | Escalate AWS quota increase with DevOps | 2026-09-02 |
binary_cases.fail_fixture: One-sided list with only subordinate tasks and no manager commitments or unblocking actions.

binary_cases.pass_rule: Addresses the core 1:1 pillars: Energy/Morale, Strategic Priorities, Obstacles/Unblocking, and Growth/Feedback.
must_not: generic status update reciting Jira tickets
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
## 1. Pulse & Energy Check
- Morale: High
## 2. Priority Alignment
- Focus: Checkout v2
## 3. Obstacles & Unblocking
- Blocker: Stalled PR review
## 4. Growth & Feedback
- Stretch Goal: Lead architecture review
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Generic status update reciting Jira tickets with no coaching or unblocking discussions.

binary_cases.prompt: Record next steps from this one-on-one.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Enforces single human DRI per action item with hard deadlines.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
| Single Owner (DRI) | Action Item | Deadline |
| @Alex | Deliver tech spec | 2026-09-06 |
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Tasks: @Team will handle the spec and someone will look at it later.

binary_cases.prompt: Format 1:1 action items using ASD-STE100 technical English.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Starts every commitment with an imperative action verb and adheres to concise sentence limits.
must_not: will try to get around to
binary_cases.pass_fixture: @Sarah (Manager): Escalate database migration approval with SecOps by 2026-09-03.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Sarah is planning on maybe checking out the migration approval and will try to get around to it.
